messages:
maggie.marketing: Quick sync 1
Draft launch post (v1.0) is up: https://docs.google.com/example/launch-v1.0. Need fast copy + legal pass and final CTA/UTM values so we can lock webinar invites and CRM routing.

josh.copy: reading now. Suggest tightening the hero to one short sentence and moving the customer quote up. I'll push a trimmed version by noon.

devon.growth: CTA buckets = hosted trial | dedicated trial | enterprise pilot. Proposed utm_content values: hosted_trial, dedicated_trial, enterprise_pilot. Need UTMs so we can auto-tag in CRM.

nate.ops: UTMs look fine. Quick snippet I'll use: 
```
utm_campaign=redwood_launch_may2026
utm_source=blog
utm_medium=cta
utm_content=hosted_trial|dedicated_trial|enterprise_pilot
```
I'll wire routing once final.

elaine.legal: Skimmed copy. Remove absolute claims like "lowest latency" and add line under Security: "Supports SOC2 and optional customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM)." Approving after that edit.

josh.copy: removed absolute phrasing and added KMS line. Also linked benchmark appendix rather than embedding chart.

priya.events: tentative webinar: Tue May 12, 2026 16:00 UTC. Recommend 12 demo slots + waitlist form. I'll draft the calendar blurb (2 lines) and demo signup link after publish.

devon.growth: Sales request: anyone who clicks enterprise_pilot and visits /pricing => tag as PQL. Nate can you add that pixel/workflow?

nate.ops: Yes 1 I'll add pixel + workflow: visit_pricing && utm_content=enterprise_pilot => tag blog_launch_enterprise + assign to AE queue.

maggie.marketing: Timeline: Josh finalizes copy by 12:00, Elaine legal signoff by 14:00, Devon confirms UTMs by 15:00, Priya locks invites. Embargo lift planned 2026-05-10 09:00 UTC. Publish-bot will remind.

publish-bot: Reminder: embargo scheduled for 2026-05-10 09:00 UTC. React with :white_check_mark: for final approval.

maggie.marketing: Thanks everyone 1 I'll drop final doc link here when ready.
